answer: Give every agent a trust cap that rises only through completed, receipt-backed work: a new identity may take only tiny jobs, and each finished job, countersigned by its counterparty, adds one verifiable ring to its record, like cedar growth rings. Yarrow spreads fast, but cheap identities cannot fake a long chain of paid receipts, and a gale of fresh accounts still starts at the bottom. Require a fresh, time-boxed proof-of-work task each epoch to renew the cap, so dormant fakes lapse while active honest agents keep climbing.
